event: Errol Brannon gets word that what they owe is wanted sooner than agreed.

name: Cassius Bello
action: passes the sponge to Elias
thought: Kids keep the kitchen alive even in rain

name: Errol Brannon
action: counts cash, glances at his watch
thought: They want the debt paid before sunset

speech.text: We need that money today, any word?

name: Etta Bello
action: shakes water off the plant pot
thought: Rain shouldn't ruin the little garden here

name: Jonah Adeyemi
action: pauses TV, points at the screen
thought: The cartoon is funny, but I want to be heard

speech.text: Did you see that? My turn to talk

name: Maren Bello
action: adjusts pillow, eyes still half‑closed
thought: Napping keeps me from the noise outside

name: Nia Nakamura
action: takes a drag, watches the rain
thought: One day I'll run this place, not just smoke

speech.text: The night shift will be quieter tomorrow

name: Ada Bello
action: folds a shirt, counts the sleeves
thought: Numbers in laundry feel like a puzzle

speech.text: Help me match these socks, please

event: There is a funeral on Delmar. Most of the block goes. Some people who should be there are not.

name: Cal Doyle
action: listens to rain, radio low
thought: I’m waiting for something to change

name: Cal Mbeki
action: eats quietly, eyes rain
thought: Family’s future feels farther each day

name: Farrah Lindqvist
action: glances at TV, rain drumming
thought: The night feels endless

name: Marisol Vasquez
action: cooks stew, watches TV
thought: Ground holds me, even in storms

name: Marta Doyle
action: stares at screen, rain steady
thought: Brother’s disappearance haunts me

name: Rey Vasquez
action: eats slowly, avoids Nia’s stare
thought: Feud with Nia burns, but I stay

name: Femi Adeyemi
action: watches TV, thinks of mortgage
thought: Mortgage feels impossible with bans

event: Ofc. Brady Kohl pulls a file that should have been closed years ago and cannot put it back.

name: Jonah Bello
action: nudges Otis with a stockinged foot in the dark
thought: Otis knows what a hundred-dollar fine actually does to people.

speech.text: Otis. You awake? Rain's coming through the sill.

name: Jonah Bello
action: curls knees to chest beneath the thin quilt
thought: The rain on the corrugated tin sounds like thrown pebbles.

name: Otis Bello
action: rolls over on the floorboards, pulling his collar tight
thought: If I open my eyes, I have to be oldest.

speech.text: Put a rag under it and shut up, Jonah.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: blinks at the static glare, nudging Rey's foot
thought: The news has not changed and Pop will not move.

speech.text: Pop, turn the volume down. It is past two.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: breathes unevenly against the damp wall, clutching a sweater
thought: The clinic opens at seven whether Isaac is here or not.

text: Day 943: the city took $2,070 and spent $900. Treasury $423,892.

name: Farrah Osei
action: flicks ash past the wet threshold
thought: Hector thinks the tin roof pays for the leak in the floor.

speech.text: Belt on three's slipping again. Don't look at me like that, Hector.

name: Booker Lyle
action: lines up brass clocks without meeting Wes's eye
thought: Doyle stands there smelling of damp wool and empty pockets.

speech.text: Two weeks past due, Wes. Don't tell me about the weather.

name: Milo Adeyemi
action: sets the dented moka pot on the burner
thought: Rufus sleeps like someone hit him with a club.

speech.text: Get up. Maren's taking the half-shift and leaving the cups.

name: Milo Bello
action: pulls the rough blanket over his chin
thought: Too loud in this room every morning before the sun even shows.

name: Rufus Adeyemi
action: swings his legs off the cot slowly
thought: Milo rattles the metal like he wants the whole flat awake.

speech.text: Don't burn it. Turn the gas down like she told you.

name: Cassius Reyes
action: scrubs a grease ring off the tin pan hard
thought: Elias thinks breathing over my shoulder makes the soap work faster.

speech.text: Take a step back, Elias. You're blocking what little light's coming through.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: hangs up the precinct receiver with a heavy clatter
thought: Nobody downtown wants to sign off on another warrant for Lyle's people.

speech.text: DA's office kicked it back. Said the paperwork lacks fresh probable cause.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: slides a warm mug of chicory across the counter
thought: If Amara takes the midday rush, maybe I can actually sit down.

speech.text: Drink it while it's hot. Rain's going to drive them inside soon.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: turns his collar up against the doorway mist
thought: Rain washes out the street, but the price per foot stays high.

speech.text: Awful wet afternoon to be waiting on Marcus Calloway's front step.

name: Sgt. Hal Brennan
action: marks a red line through a transfer form slowly
thought: If Yolanda pushes Lyle this month, it lands squarely on my desk.

speech.text: Then let it sit, Yolanda. Don't go kicking doors without paper.

event: City inspectors are working their way down Delmar with clipboards.

name: Cassius Reyes
text: Cassius Reyes will not let go of something Elias Reyes said weeks ago.
